name: Clear NVIDIA Shader Cache
description: Removes NVIDIA shader cache files to resolve graphical glitches or stutters caused by corrupted data. Games will rebuild the cache on next launch, which may temporarily increase loading times.

description_i18n.en: Removes NVIDIA shader cache files to resolve graphical glitches or stutters caused by corrupted data. Games will rebuild the cache on next launch, which may temporarily increase loading times.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt NVIDIA-Shader-Cache-Dateien zur Behebung von Grafikfehlern oder Stottern durch beschädigte Daten. Spiele erstellen den Cache beim nächsten Start neu, was die Ladezeiten vorübergehend erhöhen kann.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les fichiers de cache des shaders NVIDIA pour résoudre des graphismes défectueux ou des saccades causés par des données corrompues. Les jeux recréeront le cache au prochain lancement, ce qui peut augmenter temporairement les temps de chargement.

warnings.title: Temporary Performance Impact
warnings.message: Games may rebuild shaders after cleanup, causing longer loading times and short stutters during the first launch. Some files may be locked while games or NVIDIA services are running

technical_details: Deletes shader cache files from ProgramData\NVIDIA Corporation and LocalAppData directories including DXCache, GLCache, NV_Cache, ComputeCache, and vendor-specific paths The action does not disable the caching feature; Windows or games will automatically recreate these folders upon next launch
